info.title: Respondi API
info.description: Auth and account API for Respondi. Paths are relative to the /api base. The account id is the Cognito access token subject.

CognitoAuth.description: Cognito access token. The account id is the token subject and is never accepted in the path, query, or body.

Conflict.description: The write conflicts with an existing phone number, FAQ limit, or concurrent update.

start.description: Local time, HH:mm. Must be before end on the same day.

productId.description: Optional service id for this window. Null or omitted means the window applies to all services.

accountId.description: Cognito subject of the signed-in user.

email.description: Copied from Cognito. Writes that send email are rejected.

phone.description: E.164 business number used to match incoming WhatsApp messages.

contactPhone.description: Optional contact number in E.164. This number is not used to match WhatsApp messages.

hours.description: Business-wide hours. Always empty when scheduleMode is per_address.

conversationsThisMonth.description: New WhatsApp conversation threads started in conversationsMonth (UTC). Lazily resets on month change.

conversationsMonthlyLimit.description: Max new conversation threads allowed per UTC month.

ProfileWrite.description: Email and account id are not accepted. When scheduleMode is business, hours is required. When it is per_address, hours must be omitted or empty.

ProfilePatch.description: At least one field is required. Switching scheduleMode to business requires hours.

delete.description:
Deletes the per-account business token and ids. Does not change the profile phone
or call Meta to unregister the number.

post.summary: Complete WhatsApp Embedded Signup for the signed-in account
post.description:
Exchanges the Meta Embedded Signup `code` for a business token, subscribes
the Respondi app to the customer's WABA webhooks, optionally registers the
phone for Cloud API, stores the connection on the account, and syncs the
profile phone to Meta's `display_phone_number`.

Frontend must POST immediately — the exchangeable code expires in ~30s.
Send `wabaId` and `phoneNumberId` from the `WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP` session event.

get.description:
Meta sends this GET when the Callback URL or Verify token is set in the App Dashboard.
On success the response body is the plain-text hub.challenge value (not JSON).
This route is public. Protect it with the Secrets Manager verifyToken, API Gateway throttling, and WAF IP rate limits.

200.description: Verification accepted. Body is hub.challenge as text/plain.

403.description: Verify token mismatch or missing configuration

post.summary: Receive WhatsApp Cloud API webhook events
post.description:
Accepts Meta WhatsApp message webhooks. Validates X-Hub-Signature-256 with Secrets
Manager `appSecret`. Resolves the business via `metadata.display_phone_number` →
PHONE# lookup, loads short-lived conversation history (last 6 turns), classifies
with Nova Micro (sources multi-label), loads Dynamo context, then drafts a reply
with Amazon Nova Pro, persists conversation history, then sends via Cloud API
`POST /{phone-number-id}/messages` when Secrets Manager `accessToken` is set.
The 200 body still includes `whatsappMessage`. Conversations use creation-time SK and
DynamoDB TTL (`expiresAt` = createdAt + 1 hour). While `appSecret` is REPLACE_ME,
signature verification is skipped; while `accessToken` is REPLACE_ME, send is skipped.
Optional body `isSimulation: true` (Respondi test clients only) also skips Cloud API send.
Optional body `startClean: true` deletes any existing conversation for the customer
phone before processing so the turn starts with empty history.
New conversation threads are capped at 100 per UTC calendar month per account (lazy reset).
After an auto-reply from business B to customer A, writes short-lived
`BLOCK#A#B` (TTL 1 hour). If A is also a Respondi business and later receives
B's message, the webhook skips auto-reply so coexistence phones do not loop.

parameters.name: X-Hub-Signature-256
parameters.description:
Meta webhook signature (`sha256=` + hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body). Required
once Secrets Manager `appSecret` is a real value; optional while it is REPLACE_ME.

isSimulation.description:
Respondi test harness only. When true, runs the full reply pipeline but
does not call WhatsApp Cloud API send. Meta webhooks omit this field.

startClean.description:
Respondi test harness only. When true, deletes any existing conversation
for the customer phone before processing so history starts empty.
Meta webhooks omit this field.

200.description: Webhook accepted; includes outbound WhatsApp Cloud API message body

to.description: Customer phone as Meta expects it (usually digits, no +)

400.description: Invalid payload, missing phone, or missing text message

404.description: No account owns the business phone in the payload

422.description:
Message is not business-related, or it is business-related but account
data cannot answer it (no outbound WhatsApp message is produced).

429.description: Monthly WhatsApp conversation quota exceeded (100 / UTC month)
